thread:
maria_sullivan: hey team — quick sync on the console telemetry sprint. posting a short status + open questions. :wave:

vikram: thanks maria. go ahead — curious about tracing hook cadence and retention gaps. :eyes:

maria_sullivan: TL;DR: dashboards mostly ready (panel tweaks), tracing hooks need one more infra change (header propagation), error-analysis view needs schema mapping, retention milestone at 90d is blocked by storage quota approval.

anya: on tracing hooks — do we have a concrete plan for propagating request.meta.client_id through async hops? last attempt lost it in the job queue.

vikram: yep — plan is to add a short header x-rd-client to span context and have the runtime copy it into the OTEL attributes at span start. I posted a small patch in the runtime repo: https://git.internal/runtime/pulls/421 (PTAL).

caroline: @vikram can you confirm if that header will be present for batch jobs (batcher->worker) or only api->runtime? We need it in our dashboard filters.

vikram: good catch — current patch covers api->runtime. I'll extend the batcher adapter to surface it, but needs a tiny change in batcher config (see below).

sam_k: storage quota ask — finance said the 90d tier needs business justification doc. Who's drafting that?

maria_sullivan: volunteering to draft the doc. will sketch costs (S3 + index) and the benefit (longer lookback for regression alerts). @caroline can you add a sample alert playbook to justify ops time saved?

caroline: sure — will drop a short playbook by EOD.

lee: quick note on dashboards — Jason from product asked that the error breakdown include 'model-variant' and 'route' fields. We need mapping from trace attributes to the logs index keys. Is that decided?

anya: mapping exists but not fully wired. current mapping: span.attr.model -> logs.model, span.attr.route -> logs.route. We need the model-variant part added: span.attr.variant -> logs.variant. I'll add the transformation in the trace-collector pipeline.

maria_sullivan: great. checklist for next steps: 
- vikram: extend header propagation to batcher (PR + deploy)
- anya: update trace-collector transform for variant mapping
- caroline: alert playbook draft
- maria_sullivan: storage justification doc + cost numbers
- sam_k: file the quota request with finance once doc ready

sam_k: timeline?

maria_sullivan: aiming for next Tue milestone: hooks deployed to staging, dashboard panels updated, playbook + doc in google drive. final production deploy by Friday if no issues.

ops-bot: Reminder: staging deploy window tomorrow 03:30-04:00 UTC. Please mark rollback plans in the deploy ticket.

vikram: noted — I'll include a toggle flag for header propagation so we can flip if anything breaks.

anya: small question: retention export job needs to include traces meta for export — is that allowed with current privacy settings?

caroline: we should filter PII. For now include only synthetic id, model, route, variant, timestamp. ops will enforce scrub rule.

maria_sullivan: blockers?

vikram: my blocker is a test flake in batcher CI — failing when header is >256 chars. will add truncation and a unit test.

anya: no blockers on transform side.

caroline: finance review might take 48-72h after doc submit. we might need temporary retention workaround (compress + short index) if approval lags.

maria_sullivan: ok plan B noted. I'll ping again with links to the PRs and the doc when ready. thanks all. :thumbsup:

lee: thanks — ping me if you want product to prioritize any dashboard UI change.

maria_sullivan: last note — tagging owners for clarity: tracing hooks -> vikram, trace transforms -> anya, dashboard panels -> lee, retention approval -> sam_k + finance, ops/playbook -> caroline.

vikram: copying that into the sprint ticket now.

maria_sullivan: closing the thread for async follow-ups — post PR links here and I'll update the milestone.
